purpose: Teach: 別段/係り/入れ替わり/直轄/年俸/引上げ/支配人/バランスシート

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、創業時、別段の優遇を社員に与えられたぞ
lines.en: When I started the company, I made sure to give our staff special consideration.
lines.style: Measured, nostalgic reminiscence. Slow cadence, the weight of memory in each phrase. Voice carries quiet pride without self-regard. Gently expansive breathing.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは受付係りも自ら指導された
lines.en: Yes — he took the time to personally train even our reception staff.
lines.style: Respectful, steady acknowledgment. Measured pace. Soft emphasis on 'personally' — a son recognizing his father's hands-on nature. No rush. Grounded and present.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、幹部の入れ替わり時の判断が見事だったぞ
lines.en: Your judgment during those executive transitions was remarkable — truly masterful.
lines.style: Warm admiration with the cadence of memory. Each phrase deliberate and weighted. Trailing slightly upward at the end as if asking the past to confirm itself. Eyes in the distance.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは本社直轄の精鋭部隊を作られた
lines.en: Yes — he built a lean, elite team directly under headquarters control.
lines.style: Steady, almost meditative reflection. Even pacing, each detail given equal weight. Voice neither rushed nor stalling. The tone of someone reciting something important they've held a long time.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、社員の年俸引上げを毎年決断されたぞ
lines.en: Every year, he made the decision to raise our people's salaries without fail.
lines.style: Quiet wonder underlying steady tone. Each sentence a small affirmation. Breath flows naturally but purposefully. The cadence of gratitude for consistent kindness.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは最低給与の引上げに積極的でらした
lines.en: Yes — he was deeply committed to raising the floor — even our lowest wages.
lines.style: Humble, clear-eyed respect. Slight emphasis on 'lowest' — recognition of what that choice meant. Not boasting, just stating a fact that mattered. Even, grounded delivery.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、各店舗の支配人と毎月面談されたぞ
lines.en: He met with every store manager, every single month, without exception.
lines.style: Admiring recollection. Slow, deliberate pacing that honors the discipline being described. Voice carries the weight of that consistency. Trailing breath at the end — the echo of that dedication.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんはバランスシートを毎日確認された
lines.en: Yes — and he reviewed the balance sheet every single day himself.
lines.style: Quiet gravitas closing the arc. Slow, measured, almost ceremonial. The voice of someone who understands what that daily discipline meant. Steady and complete, without theatrical trailing.
